text:
tara.sales: Heads-up — Meridian wants a 2-week POC to evaluate switching from HelixAPI to Redwood. Primary asks: prompt parity (including function-calls), stable session handshake/state, KMS-backed key rotation, and a clear billing reconciliation for token-count differences. Can someone own tech + security Qs?

ben.se: I can start. Do they use streaming + tool-calls in prod? That usually drives most parity problems.

tara.sales: Yes — streaming + function-calls + stateful conversation sessions. They also said Helix does per-call session tokens for affinity.

kevin.eng: I'll take prompt parity + response deltas. Short plan: create a mapping shim that normalizes tokenization + whitespace + function-call ordering. Run their sample prompts through our eval harness (n=1k if they provide). Need sample set + expected outputs.

tara.sales: They sent a small sample — pasting below. Also pricing Q: Helix bills input+output but tokenization is slightly different; they want delta estimate so their finance can model spend.

ben.se: Paste sample pls.

tara.sales: ```curl -X POST https://api.helix.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"helix-large","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the 3Q revenue notes."}],"stream":true}' -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>"

Response (Helix):
{"id":"r1","choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"Q3 revenue increased 12%\nKey drivers: ..."},"finish_reason":"stop"}]}
```

kevin.eng: Quick notes after a cursory check: two big delta sources — tokenizer variant (unicode normalization + emoji handling) and Helix trims trailing whitespace/newlines in a prefilter. Also Helix serializes tool calls which affects deterministic outputs. We'll add a tokenizer shim + optional tool-call serialization mode.

sasha.security: KMS note: customer requires key rotation every 90 days and HSM import capability. Hosted customers currently can't import keys into our HSM; Dedicated and Private support BYK (Bring Your Key) with KMS integration. For POC we can enable BYK on a Dedicated pool but need an addendum and some ops lead time.

maria.legal: I can draft the BYK addendum + NDA amendment. Also they flagged SOC2 and EU data residency. We'll need to confirm eu-west Dedicated capacity for the POC.

kevin.eng: Residency is fine — we can provision a small eu-west dedicated pool for POC. Note: latency SLOs may differ for Dedicated until we tune batching. For the parity harness, expect token-count delta ~+5-12% in early runs; streaming chunking and function-call framing can add variance up to ~20% on worst-case messages.

tara.sales: Two-week timeline — are we comfortable? They want smoke tests, parity report, KMS path, and a preliminary cost delta estimate.

ben.se: Tight but doable. Action list: 1) eng to run parity harness on provided prompt set and produce token delta + response-diff samples; 2) security to confirm BYK steps and expected lead time; 3) legal to prepare addendum; 4) sales to capture acceptance criteria and discount ask.

kevin.eng: I'll run the initial pass today. Early hypothesis: if we enable tokenizer shim + `serialize-tools` toggle, we should hit functional parity for >=90% of calls. I'll post a short diff report (sample responses + token counts).

deploy-bot: POC infra request queued by tara.sales: dedicated eu-west pool (2xA100) + private KMS enabled (BYK). ETA: 4 hours for infra provisioning.

tara.sales: Thanks — Ben, can you own customer communications/kickoff scheduling? I'll include acceptance criteria: parity pass rate >=90% on their golden set, token-delta estimate, and confirmation of BYK path.

ben.se: On it. One more operational ask: add a fallback routing rule for the POC — if 95th percentile latency >600ms, auto-route to Helix-compat lower-cost variant (to keep UX acceptable). Also confirm how we’ll present billing delta: absolute token delta + projected monthly $ impact using their historic call volume.

kevin.eng: Good catch. Also found a deterministic ordering difference for function-call args — Helix orders args by schema insertion order; our runtime may reorder. I'll add a compatibility header: `X-compat-serialize-tools: true` which forces ordered tool-call serialization.

tara.sales: Perfect — I'll add the header to the POC acceptance doc.

ben.se: I'll update the customer with plan + ask them for the 1k golden prompts and a sample of any server-side postprocessing they do.

maria.legal: I'll circulate the BYK addendum draft by EOD.

sasha.security: I'll confirm BYK operational checklist and any audit logs we need to enable.

kevin.eng: Posting first parity smoke (summary) in 2h — will include token deltas and 10 example response diffs.

tara.sales: Thanks team. Quickwins: tokenizer shim + `serialize-tools` toggle + provisional BYK on Dedicated. I’ll book kickoff for tomorrow. :thumbsup:
